testcase.name: a photo already inside the limit is not sampled
a rotate-90 photo decodes untouched with a 90 degree draw rotation, and displays with swapped dimensions
the longest edge is what is bounded, whichever axis it is on
a rotate-270 photo displays with swapped dimensions too
the rotation fit correction is the ratio of the rotated fit to the unrotated fit
one pixel over the limit halves
sample sizes climb by powers of two until the floored edge fits
a mirrored orientation is baked into the bitmap and leaves no draw rotation
an untagged photo decodes with no rotation and its own dimensions
a non-positive limit is rejected rather than looping
